'''A.E. Kifisia Football Club''' ({{Langx|el|Α.Ε. Κηφισιά}}) is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Kifissia]], a suburban town in the [[Athens#Athens Urban Area|Athens agglomeration]], Greece. It was founded in 2012 after the merger of A.O. Kifisia and A.O.K. Elpidoforos. They compete in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]]."}}
